focus: Automation with nil/empty subject template — full chain handling

tests.name: create_template_with_nil_subject
tests.description: Create a ChannelMessageTemplate with subject explicitly set to nil
tests.detail: Template created successfully. The channel_message_templates.subject column is nullable (no NOT NULL constraint), so nil is accepted.

tests.name: parse_text_nil_returns_empty_string
tests.detail: parse_text(nil) returns '' via the early-return guard `return '' if text.blank?`

tests.name: automation_nil_subject_creates_channel_message
tests.description: Run CreateStageAutomationMessage interactor with nil subject from template, verify channel_message is created with blank subject
tests.detail: channel_message created successfully with subject="" (empty string after parse_text converts nil to '')

tests.name: mailer_fallback_fires_for_blank_subject
tests.description: Verify the mailer's fallback subject fires when channel_message.subject is blank
tests.detail: The mailer line `@channel_message.subject.presence || "#{@job.title} at #{@organization.name}"` correctly produces 'Software Engineer at Acme Inc.' when subject is blank

tests.name: send_template_email_subject_not_blank
tests.description: Verify the fallback subject is non-blank so SendTemplateEmail#add_subject does not raise
tests.detail: Fallback subject 'Software Engineer at Acme Inc.' is present, so the `raise 'No subject provided' if subject.blank?` guard in SendTemplateEmail does not fire

tests.name: create_template_with_empty_subject
tests.description: Create a ChannelMessageTemplate with subject set to empty string ''

tests.name: parse_text_empty_string_returns_empty_string
tests.detail: parse_text('') returns '' via the blank? guard

tests.name: bulk_parse_text_empty_string
tests.description: Verify BulkChannelMessageSendJob#parse_text with empty string returns ''
tests.detail: BulkChannelMessageSendJob has its own parse_text method (different signature: user, job_application, text) but the same blank? guard

tests.name: automation_empty_subject_creates_channel_message
tests.description: Run interactor with empty string subject, verify channel_message is created

tests.name: mailer_fallback_fires_for_empty_string_subject
tests.description: Verify mailer fallback fires for empty string subject (same as nil case)
tests.detail: ''.presence returns nil, so fallback fires correctly

tests.name: channel_message_blank_subject_is_valid
tests.description: Verify a channel_message with blank subject passes all validations
tests.detail: valid? returns true — the custom_channel_message validator does not require subject presence

tests.name: validator_allows_nil_subject
tests.description: Verify CustomChannelMessageValidator does not reject nil subject
tests.detail: nil =~ /pattern/ returns nil (falsy), so no validation error is added

tests.name: validator_allows_empty_subject
tests.description: Verify CustomChannelMessageValidator does not reject empty string subject
tests.detail: '' =~ /pattern/ returns nil (falsy), so no validation error is added

tests.name: validator_rejects_unresolved_placeholder_in_subject
tests.description: Verify CustomChannelMessageValidator correctly rejects unresolved placeholders in subject
tests.detail: Subject '{{UnknownVar}}' triggers the validator, proving subject validation is active and working

summary: All 15 tests pass. The automation pipeline handles nil and empty-string subjects correctly through the full chain: ChannelMessageTemplate (nullable subject column) -> HiringStageMessageAutomationJob (reads template.subject, passes nil/empty to interactor) -> CreateStageAutomationMessage#parse_text (blank? guard returns '') -> ChannelMessage (created with subject='', passes validation) -> ChannelMessageMailer#notify_candidate (subject.presence falls back to 'Job Title at Org Name') -> SendTemplateEmail (receives non-blank fallback subject, no raise). The BulkChannelMessageSendJob parse_text also handles nil/empty correctly with the same pattern. The CustomChannelMessageValidator correctly allows nil/empty subjects while still catching unresolved placeholders like {{Something}}. No bugs found.
